core_meaning.short_meaning: Servant of al-Muttalib; the name of the Prophet's grandfather
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abdulmuttalib (عبد المطلب) is a compound name meaning “servant of al-Muttalib”. It is the name by which Shayba ibn Hashim, the Prophet Muhammad's paternal grandfather, was known. The second element is a personal name rather than an attribute of God, so the compound is not one of the theophoric ʿAbd names such as Abdullah.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The first element عبد means “servant” and the second is the proper name المطلب. Ibn Hisham's Sirah reports that Shayba was raised by his uncle al-Muttalib and became known as Abd al-Muttalib. The name is historical and is not a Qur'anic term or a divine attribute.
